RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are women, meaning sex was almost certainly not a deciding factor in choosing between you. Raising the panel's gender composition would appear unfounded and could harm your professional reputation within the civil service. An all-female panel is neither evidence of bias nor unusual; it often simply reflects department demographics or scheduling availability. 

Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting your feedback. A two-week wait is common in government HR processes. When the feedback arrives, focus on the substantive differences in experience—such as the appointee's international project leadership—to identify how to position yourself successfully for future senior appointments.
